source.name: Open Food Facts — source-separated community product subset
source.attribution: Contains information from Open Food Facts, made available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
source.quality: Identity, source serving units and arithmetic checked. Source community data are not independently current-package verified.
source.scope: All source brands in eight existing supported markets; explicit g/mL servings and quality gates. Community imports, not full retailer inventory.
source.images: No product images copied. OFF images have separate CC BY-SA and package rights.
source.carbohydrateDefinition: Retained carbohydrates_100g field; total-versus-available not established by TSV. No fiber adjustment.

searchPolicy: Exact barcode first; brand/name tokens; source modified date descending. Market, package and formulation identities remain distinct.
availability: Community source labels, not live retailer inventory or independent package verification.
